evidence_items.explanation: The report documents the training resources of the December V3 model and compares its performance with leading models. Its resource total covers the official training stages and excludes earlier research and ablation experiments; the comparative magnitude is supplied by e2.

This independent calculation estimates an approximately tenfold training-compute advantage for the December V3 model against a similarly performing baseline. It relies on reported hardware hours and an assumed 40% hardware utilization, so it is an estimate rather than an independent measurement of the training run.

This later evaluation limits any inference that V3 matched leading models on every capability, particularly autonomous AI research tasks. The date identifies publication of the evaluation; exact testing dates are not supplied, and the item is not used as outcome evidence for the target period.

unresolved_gaps: The cited analysis does not independently verify DeepSeek's training-resource records.
There is no controlled comparison covering all development work, hardware, and capabilities.
These results do not establish the size or timing of further efficiency gains beyond the demonstrated improvements.
